bonuses.title: 30 Days Free - Intentional Travelers Toolkit Membership
bonuses.description_html:
Unlock the secrets to crafting unforgettable itineraries, discovering hidden gems, and enjoying seamless travels—all while saving time and avoiding costly pitfalls.

Enjoy full access all of Michelle's travel courses with our growing library of video tutorials, checklists, destination resources, and monthly travel tips, at no cost for the first 30 days.

  • Learn the secrets to making the most of your time and trip budget
  • Harness simple tools to find hidden gems in any destination
  • Gain confidence that you're not missing out on better experiences elsewhere in your destination
  • Eliminate hours of fruitless trip research on the internet with shortcuts for creating your own custom itineraries
  • Arrive in new destinations with more confidence and ease
